title: RTP: opus playback
description:
It's possible to play opus payload with libopus (https://opus-codec.org/).
Closes #16882.

Signed-off-by: Lin Sun <sunlin7@yahoo.com>\
Signed-off-by: Yuanzhi Li <ryanlee@ustc.edu.cn>

notes.body:
Hi @all ,
I open this pull request for adding opus support for plugin/codec.

And the opus-devel should be uploaded to https://anonsvn.wireshark.org/wireshark-win32-libs/trunk/packages/ for windows.
How can I upload the zip files to the anonsvn please?

Hi,

you can't do it by yourself but we can do it for you. Are you the one who generated the win32/win64 libraries? If yes, how was it done? Is the procedure explained in a file in the archive? If no, is it provided by the Opus project itself?

Hi @pquantin , 
The opus (three-clause BSD license) has official release https://archive.mozilla.org/pub/opus/opus-1.3.1.tar.gz, and the vs project `win32/VS2015/opus.sln` is in the tarball. 
The opus (*.h/*.lib/*.dll) for windows also available via vcpkg. 
Shall I compile it in my local and upload the *.h/*.lib/*.dll? 
Or is there a wiki for this situation please?
If there is a vcpkg recipe, I can take care of generating it and uploading it to anonsvn. Only core developers have write access to this repository.
Hi @pquantin , that's great, the opus vcpkg meta file is https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/tree/master/ports/opus.

The library generated by vcpkg is named opus.dll and not libopus.dll, which collides with the plugin that is also named opus.dll... I tried hacking opus CMakefile.txt file to prepend the lib to the name, but did not have much success up to now and I must stop for today.
Worst case we might have to rename the plugin to avoid the collision.
I will give it a last try tomorrow to see if I can generate MSVC solution files and manually modify them, but if it fails I propose to rename the plugin to opusdec.

Hi @pquantin ,

Rename plugin/codec/opus to */opusdec is a good idea, it will change nothing from opus-official release, and won't bother you neither.

Hi @pquantin ,

I had rename the codec\/opus to codec\/**opus_dec**, while the `opusdec` maybe imply it's another codec than `opus` for people who not family with this codec.\
Please review the changes again. Thank you.
And the plugin name will be opus_dec.so/opus_dec.dll now.
Windows support is added in version 5
We would also need pcaps to test the feature. You can create an enhancement issue to attach them for example, and reference the issue in your commit message.
Hi @pquantin , I had create #16882 and attached the pcap file in the ticket.
This does not seem to be added at the right place to keep it chronologically ordered
fixed in last commit, thanks.
So will this work if the RTP payload is using 24k for example? Have you tried with a pcap using another sampling rate than 48k?
Yes, it's worked for 24k. And I had tested with opus16k, opus24k, opus48k, all these works. It's should also work with opus 8k and opus 12k.

@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+# Find the system's opus includes and library
+#
+#  OPUS_INCLUDE_DIRS - where to find opus.h
+#  OPUS_LIBRARIES    - List of libraries when using opus
+#  OPUS_FOUND        - True if opus found
+#  OPUS_DLL_DIR      - (Windows) Path to the opus DLL
+#  OPUS_DLL          - (Windows) Name of the opus DLL
+
+include( FindWSWinLibs )
+FindWSWinLibs( "opus-.*" "OPUS_HINTS" )
+
+if (NOT WIN32)
+  find_package(PkgConfig)
+  pkg_search_module(OPUS opus)
+endif()
+
+find_path(OPUS_INCLUDE_DIR
+  NAMES opus/opus.h
+  HINTS
+    "${OPUS_INCLUDE_DIRS}"
+    "${OPUS_HINTS}/include"
+  PATHS /usr/local/include /usr/include
+)
+
+find_library(OPUS_LIBRARY
+  NAMES opus
+  HINTS
+    "${OPUS_LIBRARY_DIRS}"
+    "${OPUS_HINTS}/lib"
+  PATHS /usr/local/lib /usr/lib
+)
+
+include(FindPackageHandleStandardArgs)
+find_package_handle_standard_args(OPUS DEFAULT_MSG OPUS_LIBRARY OPUS_INCLUDE_DIR)
+
+if( OPUS_FOUND )
+  set( OPUS_INCLUDE_DIRS ${OPUS_INCLUDE_DIR} )
+  set( OPUS_LIBRARIES ${OPUS_LIBRARY} )
+  if (WIN32)
+    set ( OPUS_DLL_DIR "${OPUS_HINTS}/bin"
+      CACHE PATH "Path to opus DLL"
+    )
+    file( GLOB _opus_dll RELATIVE "${OPUS_DLL_DIR}"
+      "${OPUS_DLL_DIR}/opus.dll"
+    )
+    set ( OPUS_DLL ${_opus_dll}
+      # We're storing filenames only. Should we use STRING instead?
+      CACHE FILEPATH "opus DLL file name"
+    )
+    mark_as_advanced( OPUS_DLL_DIR OPUS_DLL )
+  endif()
+else()
+  set( OPUS_INCLUDE_DIRS )
+  set( OPUS_LIBRARIES )
+endif()
+
+mark_as_advanced( OPUS_LIBRARIES OPUS_INCLUDE_DIRS )

+install_opus() {
+    if [ "$OPUS_VERSION" -a ! -f opus-$OPUS_VERSION-done ] ; then
+        echo "Downloading, building, and installing opus:"
+        [ -f opus-$OPUS_VERSION.tar.gz ] || curl -L -O https://archive.mozilla.org/pub/opus/opus-$OPUS_VERSION.tar.gz || exit 1
+        $no_build && echo "Skipping installation" && return
+        gzcat opus-$OPUS_VERSION.tar.gz | tar xf - || exit 1
+        cd opus-$OPUS_VERSION
+        CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" ./configure || exit 1
+        make $MAKE_BUILD_OPTS || exit 1
+        $DO_MAKE_INSTALL || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        touch opus-$OPUS_VERSION-done
+    fi
+}
+
+uninstall_opus() {
+    if [ ! -z "$installed_opus_version" ] ; then
+        echo "Uninstalling opus:"
+        cd opus-$installed_opus_version
+        $DO_MAKE_UNINSTALL || exit 1
+        make distclean || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        rm opus-$installed_opus_version-done
+
+        if [ "$#" -eq 1 -a "$1" = "-r" ] ; then
+            #
+            # Get rid of the previously downloaded and unpacked version.
+            #
+            rm -rf opus-$installed_opus_version
+            rm -rf opus-$installed_opus_version.tar.gz
+        fi
+
+        installed_opus_version=""
+    fi
+}

commits_data.message:
RTP: opus playback

It's possible to play opus payload with libopus (https://opus-codec.org/).
Closes #16882.

Helped-by: Pascal Quantin <pascal.quantin@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Lin Sun <lin.sun@zoom.us>
Signed-off-by: Yuanzhi Li <ryanlee@mail.ustc.edu.cn>
